Key numbers requested by customer (from call):
- p95 latency target: <=120ms for chat (context <=1024 tokens) during peak (US 9am-6pm ET)
- p99 guardrail: <=500ms, with graduated credit scheme if missed
- Throughput target: 350 RPS steady during peak; 12k tokens/sec aggregate
- Committed hardware ask: sizing options 8xA100 equiv (baseline) or 16x for headroom

- Baseline (no quant + no caching): estimated $0.000045 per token at 65% utilization with 8 GPUs committed
- With int8 quant + kernel tuning: ~30-40% lower => $0.000028/token
- With prefix/KV caching for conversational sessions (expected 35% cache hit for session traffic): further ~25% effective cost reduction on tokens served => effective $0.000021/token mixed
- Burst window pricing: 2x token rate for spikes beyond 110% sustained for >5min (negotiable)
